calc.spot_why: Spot is the CRYPTO NOVA portfolio, with no leverage. The core — Bitcoin 30%, Ether 10%, Solana 5% — is held for the long run; coins the table marks «can buy» get 7.5% each with a −20% stop; risky ones 2.5% each; at least 10% stays in dollars. At most 8 coins including the core. Another 10% of the account is extra core: BTC, ETH and SOL in the same 30 / 10 / 5 proportions.
calc.cash_why: The system always keeps at least 10% of the portfolio in dollars: that is what it uses to top up the core in dips.
calc.active_why: Active spot is «BTC momentum»: when Bitcoin rises 2.5% or more in an hour, the system buys the most liquid altcoins on spot — they usually catch up. No leverage, up to 5 positions, exit after 12 hours. Between trades this part waits in BTC; after an exit it stays in dollars for up to 3 days, until a new signal.
calc.futures_why: Futures are CRYPTO NOVA's selected signals: only strategies that passed the test on history trade this account. Every trade has a stop; the risk is 1% of the futures budget per trade, and the main strategy holds no more than 4 trades at once. Losses happen too: the stop closes a losing trade. CRYPTO NOVA's real account since 22 Oct 2026: 18 futures trades closed, 7 of them in profit.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.text: «Whale copying»: about every 30 minutes the system checks the positions of the 5 best traders on its list (over 60 days at least 20 decisions, 70% or more in profit, profits at least twice the losses) and repeats their trades, always with its own stop. Whale copying on the system's demo account since October 18: 10 trades, 7 in profit. On CRYPTO NOVA's real account since October 22, trades of this rule closed: 4, in profit: 2.

sections.title: What the whale did
sections.text: Opened a long on HYPE at 84.05, 10x leverage, a position of about $50,151. The system saw it on November 4, 20:47.

sections.title: What we track
sections.text: About every 30 minutes, his HYPE position: does he add, cut or close. We see adds and partial cuts but leave the copy as it is; when he closes or flips, we close too. The price is now 83.41: the whale is down for now, −0.8% from his entry.

sections.title: Our entry
sections.text: We entered at 83.66, into the whale's already open position: a price 0.5% better than the whale's. We join only while the price is no more than 1% worse than his entry and he is not down more than 3%; otherwise we wait for his next trade.

sections.title: Our stop
sections.text: 77.52 (−7.3% from the entry), the system's protective stop: the whale shows no stop, so we set our own 8% from the entry. The stop is placed at OKX and works even if our server is silent.

sections.title: Target and exit
sections.text: Guide: 95.93 (+14.7% from the entry, ≈ +$54 to the result), a move twice the stop (2R). It is a guide, not an order: we do not close there, since the whale may hold longer. We exit in one of two cases: the whale closes or flips his position, and we close too; or the price reaches the stop 77.52. Copies have no trailing stop.

sections.title: Risk
sections.text: Leverage 5x. At risk down to the stop: no more than $29, 2% of the futures budget.
